import math

def next_Perfect_Square(n):
    # isqrt(n) is the largest integer r with r*r <= n, so (r+1)^2 is the
    # smallest perfect square strictly greater than n.
    r = math.isqrt(n)
    return (r + 1) ** 2

assert next_Perfect_Square(35) == 36
assert next_Perfect_Square(36) == 49
assert next_Perfect_Square(0) == 1
